|sellprice = 20 |ingredients = {{Name|Hardwood|1}}{{Name|Honey|1}}{{Name|Fiber|20}} |recipe = [[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging#Foraging Skill|Foraging]] Level 8 |qiseasoning = false }} The '''Warp Totem: Farm''' is a [[Warp Totem]] that teleports the player to the farm by selecting it in inventory and {{key|right-clicking}}. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] when the recipe becomes available at [[Foraging]] Level 8. ==Other Sources== *1-3 Warp Totem: Farm may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. *Three Warp Totem: Farm may be received from opening a [[Golden Mystery Box]]. *Warp Totem: Farms can be purchased at the [[Casino]] for {{Price|1000|Qi}} each. *Five Warp Totem: Farms is the reward after donating 80 items to the [[Museum]]. *A Warp Totem: Farm can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]] during any season. *A [[Blobfish]] [[Fish Pond]] has a 1.7-1.9% chance to produce five Warp Totem: Farms if the population is at least 9. *Five Warp Totem: Farms may occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern. *Starting [[Summer]] 1 of year 1 there is a 10% chance for a Warp Totem: Farm to replace [[Clay]] in an [[Artifact Spot]]. *The [[Island Trader]] sells Warp Totem: Farms for 5 [[Taro Root]]s. *Three Warp Totem: Farm is one of the prizes from the [[Trout Derby]] festival. ==Destination== {{Map|140|75}} [[File:Warp Totem Farm location.png|400px]] ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Bundles== The Warp Totem: Farm is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== The Warp Totem: Farm can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Totem Mask|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== The Warp Totem: Farm is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be obtained from Crane Game in the [[Movie Theater]] or in [[Blobfish]] [[Fish Pond]]s.
